name: PennyLane two-qubit variational classifier for x1>0 labels
task_prompt: Build a reproducible two-qubit PennyLane variational classifier for labels defined by x1>0 on a small deterministic 2D training set. Use angle encoding, two trainable rotation-entangling layers, an expectation-value output with a trainable bias, mini-batch-free Adam optimization, and a fixed train/test split. Print loss and accuracies, assert loss decreases from initialization and all predictions are finite; do not hard-code a guaranteed accuracy threshold above 70 percent. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
